metadata.description: The Royal Thai Legation's Students' Department writes to President A. H. Upham of Miami University following the writer's return to the legation. The writer thanks Upham for courtesies received at the University, praises the work being done there, and says that being the agency through which the University secured the previous day's Commencement speaker would make the writer's “cup” run over. The letter sends regards to Mrs. Upham.
metadata.title: Letter to President A. H. Upham from the Royal Thai Legation, 2 June 1942
metadata.transcript:
[page 1]
June 2, 1942

President A. H. Upham [Alfred H. Upham]
Miami University
Oxford, Ohio

Dear President Upham:

Just a line, upon my return to the Legation, to thank you for the many courtesies which were shown to me while I was at the University, and to tell you again how proud I am of the wonderful work which you are doing there. There is a charm and a dignity about the place which I had never so thoroughly felt before. If only I could now be looking backward to the pleasure of having been the agency through whom you secured yesterday's Commencement speaker, my cup would indeed be running over. I shall still hope in that direction!

Kindest regards to Mrs. Upham and yourself.

Sincerely yours,

[handwritten] [illegible]
